title: Zephyrite
description:
Zephyrite Ore
A rare crystal ore that generates deep underground between Y=-64 and Y=-16. Rarer and better than diamonds — dig deep to find it!
From the cristals u can craft new tools and decoration items! And also in the future i`ll add more ores.
body: This mod adds new rare ore what better than diamonds and of course more rare usin zephyrite crystals you can craft some decorations and new op tools but remember the ore is worst than netherite so its not he best ore in the game good luck with mod!
